page.en: Please turn to page forty before the lesson begins.
page.zh: 上課前請翻到第四十頁。

pain.en: He felt some pain in his shoulder after carrying the boxes.
pain.zh: 搬完箱子後，他的肩膀感到有些疼痛。

paint.en: Students used bright colors to paint the classroom mural.
paint.zh: 學生用鮮豔色彩畫教室壁畫。

painting.en: The painting shows a quiet village beside the sea.
painting.zh: 這幅畫描繪海邊一座寧靜的村莊。

pair.en: Each pair of students compared their answers after the quiz.
pair.zh: 每兩位學生一組，在小考後比較答案。

paper.en: Write your final answer clearly on the paper.
paper.zh: 請把最後答案清楚寫在紙上。

paragraph.en: Each paragraph should focus on one main idea.
paragraph.zh: 每一段都應聚焦在一個主要觀念上。

parent.en: A parent attended the meeting to discuss school activities.
parent.zh: 一位家長參加會議討論學校活動。

park.en: We walked through the park after finishing our homework.
park.zh: 寫完作業後，我們穿過公園散步。

part.en: The final part of the report explains the results.
part.zh: 報告的最後一部分說明研究結果。

participate.en: All students are encouraged to participate in the class discussion.
participate.zh: 鼓勵所有學生參與課堂討論。

participation.en: Active participation can make group learning more effective.
participation.zh: 積極參與能讓小組學習更有效。

particular.en: This particular example clearly shows how the rule works.
particular.zh: 這個特定例子清楚顯示這項規則如何運作。

particularly.en: The library is particularly busy during exam week.
particularly.zh: 考試週期間圖書館特別忙碌。

partner.en: My partner checked the data while I prepared the chart.
partner.zh: 我的搭檔檢查資料，而我準備圖表。

party.en: The class held a small party after the final exam.
party.zh: 期末考後，全班舉辦了一個小聚會。

pass.en: You need to pass the final test to complete the course.
pass.zh: 你需要通過期末測驗才能完成這門課。

passage.en: Read the passage carefully before answering the questions.
passage.zh: 回答問題前請仔細閱讀文章。

passenger.en: Each passenger must keep a ticket until leaving the station.
passenger.zh: 每位乘客都必須保留車票直到離站。

past.en: The town has changed greatly over the past ten years.
past.zh: 這個城鎮在過去十年間有很大變化。

path.en: We followed the path through the forest to the lake.
path.zh: 我們沿著森林小徑走到湖邊。

patient.en: You need to be patient when learning a difficult skill.
patient.zh: 學習困難技能時需要有耐心。

pattern.en: The graph shows a clear pattern in the monthly data.
pattern.zh: 這張圖表顯示每月資料中的明顯模式。

pay.en: Students do not need to pay for the online materials.
pay.zh: 學生不需要為線上教材付費。

peace.en: The two groups worked together to promote peace in the community.
peace.zh: 兩個團體合作促進社區和平。

pen.en: I used a blue pen to correct the final draft.
pen.zh: 我用藍筆修改最後一版草稿。

pencil.en: Use a pencil so you can change your answer easily.
pencil.zh: 請使用鉛筆，這樣比較容易修改答案。

people.en: Many people use public transportation to travel across the city.
people.zh: 許多人搭乘大眾運輸在城市中移動。

percent.en: About sixty percent of the students chose the first option.
percent.zh: 大約百分之六十的學生選擇第一個選項。

perfect.en: The plan is not perfect, but it is practical.
perfect.zh: 這個計畫並不完美，但很實際。

perform.en: The students will perform a short play at the festival.
perform.zh: 學生會在活動中表演一齣短劇。

performance.en: Her performance improved after several weeks of regular practice.
performance.zh: 經過數週規律練習後，她的表現進步了。

perhaps.en: Perhaps we should collect more evidence before making a decision.
perhaps.zh: 也許我們應該在做決定前蒐集更多證據。

period.en: The experiment continued for a period of three weeks.

person.en: Each person in the group was given a different task.
person.zh: 小組中的每個人都被分配不同任務。

personal.en: Do not share personal information on an unfamiliar website.
personal.zh: 不要在陌生網站上分享個人資訊。

persuade.en: The speaker used evidence to persuade the audience to support the plan.
persuade.zh: 講者用證據說服聽眾支持這項計畫。

phone.en: Please turn off your phone during the exam.

photo.en: We took a group photo in front of the museum.
photo.zh: 我們在博物館前拍了一張團體照。

phrase.en: This phrase is commonly used in formal writing.
phrase.zh: 這個片語常用於正式寫作。

physical.en: Regular exercise supports both physical and mental health.
physical.zh: 規律運動有助於身心健康。

physics.en: Physics helps explain how motion, force, and energy are related.
physics.zh: 物理學幫助解釋運動、力與能量之間的關係。

pick.en: Please pick one topic for your final presentation.
pick.zh: 請為期末報告選一個主題。

picture.en: The picture shows how the machine is assembled.
picture.zh: 這張圖片顯示機器如何組裝。

piece.en: Each piece of evidence should support your main argument.
piece.zh: 每一項證據都應支持你的主要論點。

place.en: The meeting will take place in the school library.
place.zh: 會議將在學校圖書館舉行。

plan.en: We made a clear plan before starting the project.
plan.zh: 開始專題前，我們先擬定了清楚的計畫。

plant.en: This plant grows best in warm and sunny conditions.
plant.zh: 這種植物在溫暖且陽光充足的環境下長得最好。

plastic.en: The school is trying to reduce single-use plastic on campus.
plastic.zh: 學校正努力減少校園內的一次性塑膠。

plate.en: She placed the fruit neatly on a large plate.
plate.zh: 她把水果整齊放在一個大盤子上。

play.en: The students will play basketball after the meeting.
play.zh: 會議後學生要去打籃球。

player.en: Each player must follow the rules during the match.
player.zh: 每位球員在比賽中都必須遵守規則。

please.en: Please check the instructions before beginning the task.
please.zh: 開始任務前請先檢查說明。

point.en: The teacher explained the main point with a simple example.
point.zh: 老師用簡單例子說明主要重點。

police.en: The police closed the road after the accident.
police.zh: 事故發生後，警方封閉了道路。

policy.en: The school introduced a new policy on digital device use.
policy.zh: 學校推出了新的數位裝置使用政策。

popular.en: This study method is popular because it is simple and effective.
popular.zh: 這種讀書方法因簡單有效而很受歡迎。

population.en: The city's population has grown steadily over the last decade.
population.zh: 這座城市的人口在過去十年間穩定成長。

position.en: Please place the camera in the correct position before recording.
position.zh: 錄影前請把相機放在正確位置。

positive.en: Positive feedback can encourage students to keep improving.
positive.zh: 正向回饋能鼓勵學生持續進步。

possible.en: We considered every possible solution before choosing one.
possible.zh: 我們在做選擇前考慮了所有可能的解決方案。

possibly.en: The delay could possibly affect tomorrow's schedule.
possibly.zh: 這次延誤可能會影響明天的行程。

post.en: The teacher will post the results on the class website.
post.zh: 老師會把結果公布在班級網站上。

power.en: Solar panels can provide power for small buildings.
power.zh: 太陽能板可以為小型建築供電。

practice.en: Regular practice is the best way to improve speaking skills.
practice.zh: 規律練習是提升口說能力的最佳方式。

prepare.en: Students should prepare their notes before the discussion begins.
prepare.zh: 討論開始前，學生應先準備好筆記。

present.en: Each group will present its findings to the class tomorrow.
present.zh: 每個小組明天都要向全班報告研究結果。

presentation.en: Her presentation included clear charts and useful examples.
presentation.zh: 她的報告包含清楚的圖表與實用例子。

pressure.en: Too much pressure can make it harder to concentrate.
pressure.zh: 過大的壓力會讓人更難專心。

prevent.en: Good planning can prevent many common mistakes.
prevent.zh: 良好規劃可以避免許多常見錯誤。

price.en: The price of the ticket includes admission to the museum.
price.zh: 票價包含博物館入場費。

primary.en: Our primary goal is to improve reading comprehension.
primary.zh: 我們的主要目標是提升閱讀理解能力。

principal.en: The principal spoke to students during the morning assembly.
principal.zh: 校長在晨會時對學生致詞。

principle.en: The teacher explained the principle behind the experiment.
principle.zh: 老師解釋了這項實驗背後的原理。

print.en: Please print the report before the meeting begins.
print.zh: 會議開始前請把報告印出來。

private.en: The website keeps each user's private information protected.
private.zh: 這個網站會保護每位使用者的私人資訊。

probably.en: The bus will probably arrive within the next ten minutes.
probably.zh: 公車大概會在接下來十分鐘內抵達。

problem.en: We solved the problem by checking each step carefully.
problem.zh: 我們透過仔細檢查每個步驟解決了問題。

process.en: Learning a language is a gradual process that takes time.
process.zh: 學習語言是一個需要時間的漸進過程。

produce.en: The new method can produce more accurate results.
produce.zh: 這個新方法可以產生更準確的結果。

product.en: The company tested the product before releasing it to customers.
product.zh: 公司在產品上市前先進行測試。

professional.en: She gave a professional presentation with clear and organized slides.
professional.zh: 她用清楚有條理的投影片做了一場專業報告。

program.en: The school program helps students improve their reading skills.
program.zh: 這項學校計畫幫助學生提升閱讀能力。

project.en: Our project examines how sleep affects student learning.
project.zh: 我們的專題探討睡眠如何影響學生學習。

promise.en: He made a promise to finish his part of the work.
promise.zh: 他答應會完成自己負責的工作。

proper.en: Use proper equipment when conducting the science experiment.
proper.zh: 進行科學實驗時要使用適當設備。

properly.en: The machine will work properly if each part is installed correctly.
properly.zh: 如果每個零件都正確安裝，機器就能正常運作。

protect.en: Trees can help protect the soil from heavy rain.
protect.zh: 樹木可以幫助保護土壤免受大雨侵蝕。

provide.en: The website provides useful information for new students.
provide.zh: 這個網站為新生提供實用資訊。

public.en: The new library is open to the public on weekends.
public.zh: 新圖書館週末對大眾開放。

publish.en: The researchers will publish their findings after final review.
publish.zh: 研究人員會在最終審查後發表研究結果。

purpose.en: The purpose of this activity is to practice critical thinking.
purpose.zh: 這項活動的目的是練習批判思考。

quality.en: The team checked the quality of the data before analysis.
quality.zh: 團隊在分析前先檢查資料品質。

question.en: Please answer each question using evidence from the passage.
question.zh: 請使用文章中的證據回答每一題。

quick.en: A quick review before class can improve understanding.
quick.zh: 上課前快速複習能提升理解。

quickly.en: The students quickly organized the materials before the experiment.
quickly.zh: 學生在實驗前迅速整理好材料。

quiet.en: The library provides a quiet place for students to study.
quiet.zh: 圖書館提供學生一個安靜的讀書場所。

quite.en: The final question was quite difficult for most students.
quite.zh: 最後一題對大多數學生來說相當困難。
